daily_reality.typical_schedule: More than 40 hours per week; includes evenings, weekends, and extensive travel especially for those with sports teams
daily_tasks: Apply protective or injury preventive devices (tape, bandages, braces) to body parts such as ankles, fingers, wrists
Care for athletic injuries using physical therapy equipment, techniques, or medication
Conduct initial assessments of athlete's injury or illness to provide emergency or continued care
Evaluate athletes' readiness to play and provide participation clearances when necessary
Perform general administrative tasks such as keeping records or writing reports
morning_prep: Clean and organize athletic training room
Review game and practice schedules for the day
daily_reality.high_school_example: Arrive before student school day ends; allow students to be seen during day for PE injuries or prior-day events; at 3:00 pm school bell, training room becomes busy with student-athletes signing in for treatment

regulatory.boc_certification: ATC credential and BOC requirements recognized by 49 states plus DC for eligibility/regulation; BOC exam recognized by all state regulatory agencies
regulatory.education_requirement: Must graduate with master's degree from accredited professional athletic training education program and pass comprehensive BOC test
regulatory.state_licensing: Must be legally recognized by appropriate state regulatory agency prior to practicing; compliance with state regulatory requirements is mandatory and only avenue to legal practice
regulatory.state_variation: Each state differs in legislation affecting various athletic training domains, though many states have similar requirements
regulatory.continuing_education: Must meet ongoing continuing education requirements to retain certification
regulatory.annual_renewal_fee: Required to pay annual BOC certification renewal fee supporting administrative, disciplinary, regulatory and professional development activities
regulatory.interstate_compact_2025: CSG partnering with BOC through DoD cooperative agreement to develop new interstate compact; legislative summit held August 28, 2025; will allow ATs to practice across state lines both physically and remotely (digital health), improving continuity of care

tools.automation_benefits: Can automate 80% of workflows, reduce denials by 75%, secure approvals one week before appointments; preparing for CMS 2026 mandate

by_experience.high_end_potential: 80000+ in professional sports, spectator sports, or senior leadership

market.education_note: Master's degree now required entry point as of 2022

automation_potential.program_design: AI reduces by up to 80% the time required to design programs and analyze user behavior; automates program personalization allowing trainers to focus on coaching and human connection
automation_potential.administrative_tasks: Save up to 94% in production time through AI; trainers spend less time writing programs and scheduling, more time building relationships and hands-on coaching
automation_potential.automated_operations: Member check-ins, FAQs, renewals handled by chatbots or AI receptionists, freeing trainers to focus on actual coaching
automation_potential.data_analytics: AI analytics track KPIs (heart rate, recovery times, consistency) with ease; AI algorithms analyze movement patterns to predict injury risks
automation_potential.injury_prevention: Increased demand for sports science professionals in clinical and research settings as graduates develop personalized recovery programs integrating automation
automation_potential.adoption_trend: 65% of sports organizations plan to increase AI use by 2025
automation_potential.productivity_impact: Personal trainers using AI see 30% increase in client load while maintaining service quality
automation_potential.overall_impact: AI designed to augment rather than replace trainers, enabling focus on coaching and client relationships

documentation_issues: Failing to maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation of medical records
Not keeping patient medical information and records in secure manner (digital or paper)
error_patterns.scope_of_practice: Athletic trainers need clear understanding of state laws regarding what they can and can't do when providing patient care
informed_consent: Not ensuring patient is fully aware of all aspects associated with treatment
Failing to inform patients of likely benefits and potential risks
Not providing written notices of treatment options and alternatives
Not verifying patient is competent and not under pressure to receive care

error_patterns.compliance_standard: Must comply with BOC Standards of Professional Practice: Practice Standards and Code of Professional Responsibility
best_practices: Maintain accurate and detailed records - essential for defending against claims
Stay up-to-date with continuing education to reduce risk of negligence claims
Standardization of contemporary documentation practices is gold standard
